name: rollcall_vplayercontroller
about: Roll call: classname npc_VPlayerController builds CNPC_VPlayerController (factory 0x103a4470, research/tooling/ghidra/driver/kernel_factories.tsv). No map, maker or script authors a row of it (docs/vtmb/npc-ai/population.md § NPC classes with no instance / placed by code); a hand-written row stands it; NPCThink 0x10292de0 -> RunAI 0x1026f110 -> MaintainSchedule: on its first thinks the class's SelectSchedule (its own override or the Troika arm it inherits) picks a program and SetSchedule 0x10280e50 installs it; the program then runs (StartTask/RunTask) for the rest of the ten seconds without a task failing every think.
notes: The cast row is named playercontroller: the controller line's spawn renames the entity to it (the first run's trace carried every event under that name). Hand-written row: no authored row exists; the model is the record's choice, not retail's.
